name: The Violet Illness
source:
In a collapsed world two people try to survive. But their history can't end well. What happened to them? Why are they escaping? And what is Violet?

[From [url=https://glonicera.itch.io/violet]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个崩溃的世界里，两个人试图生存。但他们的历史不可能有好结局。他们怎么了？他们为什么要逃跑？那么紫罗兰是什么？

[来自[url=https://glonicera.itch.io/violet]Itch.io[/url]]
